_comment: Ledger rows for rules enforced by a hook alone — no lint, no replay; proven in hooks/tests/. tools/ledger.py merges them into LEDGER.md by ID and counts them as the hook tier. `rule` is the letter in hooks/README.md's rule table; `proof` is the test file (#189).

cases.title: An intake summary is written only on request
cases.ledger: an `**[intake] · summary**` write is allowed only after the gate holder's latest comment asks for it — `test_guard_gate.py` RuleA

cases.title: An agent never applies a gate label
cases.ledger: `--add-label` / `issue update --label` naming `ready-for-spec` or `ready-for-dev` is blocked across gh, glab, the `=` form, continuations and tabs — `test_guard_gate.py` RuleB, 18 cases

cases.title: The loop's worktree add runs alone
cases.ledger: a Bash call holding the loop's `git worktree add …/roz-gate/wt/…` with anything else in the segment is blocked (2.6.0, #186) — `test_guard_gate.py` RuleJ
